issues.description: Sharp rectangular collider boxes ('rotunda_core', 'rotunda_west', 'rotunda_east') protrude right through the cylindrical cella walls on the front and back of the rotunda, ruining the round classical silhouette with ugly flat square corners sticking out into the colonnade.
issues.fix: Put `collide: true` directly on the main cella `k.cylinder` (radius 7.4) or make the disjoint box colliders fit entirely inside the cylinder (e.g. `size: [10.0, 7.4, 10.0]` at `pos: [0, 3.7, -0.6]`) and narrow the front portico wall so no square edges poke outside the round rotunda.

issues.description: The building sign ('PIVOT') is placed directly over the middle of the four tall front windows (`y: 5.1`), bisecting the window panes and frames vertically, and the small pale font on the white background is nearly unreadable from the plaza.
issues.fix: Lower the front windows (`pos: [wx, 3.4, 7.62]`, `size: [0.75, 1.8, 0.18]`) or raise the sign onto the frieze/entablature or just above the door frame (`y: 4.1`) with windows flanking the door rather than behind the sign.

issues.description: There is an open gap between the top of the cylindrical cella (`y: 8.75`) and the underside of the shallow dome/entablature, allowing a view into the hollow interior of the roof mesh from street level.
issues.fix: Add a ceiling/soffit cylinder (`radiusTop: 9.3, radiusBottom: 9.3, height: 0.3, pos: [0, 8.75, -0.6], mat: 'trim'`) to close the colonnade ceiling and extend the cella cylinder height to `8.2` so it meets the dome cleanly.

issues.description: The front entrance is just a bare thin purple line on a flat wall (`k.entrance({ z: 7.6 })`) with no door leafs, recessed doorway, classical architrave, or pediment, looking unfinished.
issues.fix: Build a recessed double door (`wood_dark` panels with `metal_light` handles, recessed 0.2m) framed by classical `trim` pilasters, a lintel/cornice header, and a small canopy or portico projection.

issues.description: The exterior benches (`z: 8.2`) and flowerbeds (`z: 9.2`) clip into the bottom step of the circular stylobate (`radiusBottom: 10.8` centered at `z: -0.6`, which reaches `z: 10.2`).
issues.fix: Move the benches and flowerbeds further out from the stylobate radius or add a paved forecourt path (`plaza_stone`) extending to `z: 11.5` with planters and street lamps placed cleanly outside the steps.

issues.description: In the interior, the central easel (`pos: [0, 0, -5.4]`) sits directly in front of the north window and directly behind the Scales of Decision and lead agent (`s1`), creating visual clutter where the scales, easel, and window mullion all overlap in the primary entry view.
issues.fix: Move the north window to split into two windows flanking the center (`center: -3.5` and `center: 3.5`), and replace the center easel behind `s1` with a grand classical wall feature or framed decision board mounted higher on the north wall, or widen the easel arc.

issues.description: The interior feels slightly sparse around the mid-room and corners, and the two perimeter desks have no chairs.
issues.fix: Add `chair` props at the two side desks (`[-6.1, 0, -2.0]` and `[6.1, 0, -2.0]`), add a classical ceiling coffer ring or chandelier above the round table to echo the rotunda dome, and add more lived-in office props (`mug`, `binder`, `folder_stack`) on the council table and side desks.

keep: The custom Scales of Decision centerpiece on the round council table is immediately recognizable, well-proportioned, and strongly communicates the Pivot & Decision mission.
The circular dual-tone purple rug, round dark-wood council table with 6 chairs and individual dossier papers create a strong focal point in the decision room.
The classical 8-column colonnade, stepped circular stylobate, purple intercolumniation banners, and shallow dome with oculus lantern give the exterior a clear rotunda identity.
All 6 NPC slots and colliders pass every automated probe with zero errors.
